items.title: 68515_Budd Johnson oral history interview
items.q: a great book on orchestration by Piston

ctx.x: He showed me the technicalities. And with all of these different transposing instruments incidents, I'm having trouble with them. I don't have too much trouble with the strings but he said here, I want you to take this book and he says you just write. So he gave me a great book on orchestration by Piston, which has opened my eyes to all of these different textures and what not. So I'm going for myself, I'm writing it to him, in fact sometimes -- tomorrow I'm going over -- I've written 25 pages of music, I'm going…
Let him CHECK it Before you chicken out.
